arbiter: Published US Naval Observatory Sun rise/set ephemeris, reduced by hand with the twelve-equal-day-hours convention
terms: US Government work, as recorded in ../../LICENSING.md; attribution: US Naval Observatory, Astronomical Applications Department
clockNote: Published UT labels below have no Z suffix. The tests compare nominal coordinate differences with native UTC results using the declared threshold, without asserting that UT and UTC denote the same instant or converting physical instants between them.
thresholdBasis: Chosen before native comparison. Minute rounding, the UT versus UTC difference at the declared date, and the fixed versus distance-dependent solar semidiameter conventions fit within this one-minute comparison threshold. It is not a general physical accuracy bound.
derivation: Sunset minus sunrise is 732 minutes. Division by twelve gives 61 minutes. Friday's first and eighth hours belong to Venus in the Chaldean cycle: [05:46,06:47) and [12:53,13:54). Clipping to [06:00,14:00) gives the listed windows. All labels denote this one declared comparison; no expected boundary was obtained from the engine.
